Time Wave Ultra: Large Clock with Bluetooth Speaker, RGB Lights & Mirror Finish Display

Time Wave Ultra is more than just a table clock – it’s a stylish, multifunctional device designed for modern homes and offices. This large digital clock with Bluetooth speaker combines cutting-edge features like RGB lights, mirror finish display, FM radio, and a TF card reader, powered by a long-lasting 1200 mAh battery. Whether you want a sleek alarm or a portable music companion, the Time Wave Ultra does it all with elegance and performance.

Key Features of Time Wave Ultra

  • Bluetooth Speaker: Enjoy high-quality wireless sound by pairing your smartphone, tablet, or laptop easily via Bluetooth 5.0.
  • Mirror Finish Display: The digital mirror surface gives your room a modern touch, functioning as both a stylish decor piece and a bright LED display.
  • RGB Lights: Set the mood with dynamic RGB ambient lighting that enhances your space and matches your vibe.
  • FM Radio & TF Card Reader: Tune in to your favorite FM channels or play music directly from a memory card.
  • 1200 mAh Battery: Long-lasting rechargeable battery ensures uninterrupted use throughout the day or night.
  • Mobile Stand Function: Convenient design to hold your smartphone while you stream, watch, or charge.

Why Choose the Time Wave Ultra Large Clock?

The Time Wave Ultra large clock with Bluetooth speaker is designed to be versatile. It’s perfect for your bedside, office desk, or as a decorative LED clock in your living room. The mirror display doubles as a makeup mirror, while the RGB light feature adds a colorful ambiance to your space. Whether you’re listening to music, catching up on news, or simply checking the time, the Time Wave Ultra offers the perfect combination of technology and style.

Perfect for Gifting

Looking for a unique and practical corporate gift or a gadget for your loved ones? The Time Wave Ultra makes an excellent choice. Its multifunctional design and premium build make it a thoughtful present for birthdays, anniversaries, or festive occasions.
